key_insight: A structured neural network models anisotropic, nonlinear magnetic response through a smooth, convex co-energy density with controlled behavior at infinity.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports physically consistent magnetic-field simulations of electrical steel sheets used in transformer and generator cores.
method: Represent anhysteretic magnetic behavior using a structured neural network.
Enforce smoothness, convexity, and prescribed asymptotic behavior in the co-energy density.
Build in properties supporting well-posed magnetic-field problems and efficient numerical solvers.
evidence_signal: Numerical tests demonstrate strongly anisotropic response modeling and robust convergence in finite-element simulations.
watch_item: The model targets anhysteretic response; hysteresis and associated magnetic losses are outside the stated scope.
paper_title: Structured Neural Network Models for Anisotropic Magnetic Constitutive Laws
